messages:
Harper Lin: Quick fun idea  Bring-your-favorite-album swap + listening party this Friday? 45min, low effort, everyone plays one full album and says 1 line about it.
Diego R.: Love it. My rec: "LP#: Vampire Weekend - Contra"  one-line: sunny indie that still hits in the late-night.
Zoe Kim: I'll bring an album: Radiohead - In Rainbows. One-line: perfect headphone album, lots to dissect.
Anand V: Suggestion: keep it vinyl-friendly? If someone wants to bring records we have a turntable in the lounge. Otherwise streaming link is fine.
Rachel P: I'll do: Janelle Mone9 - The ArchAndroid. One-line: maximalist and weird in the best way. Also I can bring sparkling water. :sparkles:
Sam (intern): New-to-me recs! I'll pick something shortish: The xx - xx (2010)  chill, great for background listening.
Harper Lin: Logistics: Friday 6:30pm in the common area. 45min total so 6 people x ~7min each (album + 1-line intro + quick reaction). Bring headphones if you want to zone.
polly-bot: Poll created: "Format preference for Friday album swap" Options: Live listening in common area / Remote Spotify party (share link) / Hybrid (projector + personal headphones)
Diego R.: Voted Hybrid. Also note: projector audio sucks, I can bring a small speaker.
Zoe Kim: Voted Live listening in common area. I can bring a little sign that says "no spoilers" (jk).
Anand V: Voted Hybrid. Also: can we include a short lyric sheet for songs with sensitive topics? People have different triggers.
Rachel P: Voted Remote Spotify party. I can make a collaborative playlist and invite folks. Also two snack asks: salty + sweet.
Sam (intern): Voted Hybrid. Can someone DM me if they want to bring vinyl? I can help coordinate pickup from the lounge.
Harper Lin: Poll closes Thu 3pm. If Remote wins we'll share a collaborative playlist link and 6 tracks or a timestamped listen plan. If Hybrid/Live wins we'll test AV at 5:45 Fri.
Diego R.: One more rec in case we need backup: Arctic Monkeys - AM  great energy, easy to follow.
Zoe Kim: Also curious: anyone up for a short "why this album" lightning round instead of full album if people short on time?
Harper Lin: Yes we can do lightning round opt-in. Thanks everyone 60a I'll post a final RSVP thread tomorrow and a quick guidance doc for link sharing.
